title: carum gairdneri
intro: Carum gairdneri, commonly known as Dukhran or Gairdner's carum, is a plant species native to South Asia, belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Carum gairdneri include its antimicrobial, antiseptic, and analgesic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
